label: GBIF occurrence count for Insecta (GBIF backbone key 216), 2026-10-31
bibliographic_citation: GBIF.org (2026-10-31) GBIF Occurrence Count API, taxonKey=216 (Insecta). https://api.gbif.org/v1/occurrence/count?taxonKey=216
license: Mixed per publishing dataset (CC0 1.0, CC BY 4.0 or CC BY-NC 4.0)

counts.description: occurrence records indexed by GBIF under taxonKey 216 (Insecta, rank class) and all descendants, as returned by the count API

measurement_technique: Aggregated species-occurrence records (preserved specimens, human and machine observations) published to GBIF by its data publishers and interpreted against the GBIF backbone taxonomy; count retrieved with the occurrence/count API.
role: geographic distribution and recording effort for Insecta
